name: auto-window
title: Auto Window
description: Save multi-monitor window presets and apply them with a hotkey. Uses display roles (builtin, largest, rightmost) instead of display indexes.
author: ryan

commands.name: apply-preset
commands.title: Manage Presets
commands.subtitle: Auto Window
commands.description: Browse, edit, and apply saved window layouts.

commands.name: capture-layout
commands.title: Capture Layout
commands.subtitle: Auto Window
commands.description: Save the current window arrangement, including Spaces on each display.

commands.name: create-preset
commands.title: Create Preset
commands.subtitle: Auto Window
commands.description: Create a new window layout preset and add the apps it should place.

commands.name: apply-default
commands.title: Apply Default Preset
commands.subtitle: Auto Window
commands.description: Apply the default window layout for the current number of displays.

commands.name: apply-layout
commands.title: Apply Layout
commands.subtitle: Auto Window
commands.description: Apply a saved layout by name. Assign a hotkey via a Quicklink, or use Apply Layout 1–8.
